family: The single total family defined in proof.md Section 1: f_0=0; for n>=1 let k be the least prime with k^5>32n^3; if n<=k then f_n=0; else the first k bits give the monic polynomial Q=Z^k+sum b_j Z^j, and f_n=0 unless Z^(2^k)=Z mod Q and gcd(Q,Z^2+Z)=1; if so, with K=F_2[Z]/(Q), m=n-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)), pad the remaining m bits with zeros to r blocks of k bits read as y_i in K via the polynomial basis, and output Tr(Sym_r^t(y_1^(2^(r+1)-1), y_2^(2^r-1), ..., y_r^(2^2-1))) with Tr the absolute trace K->F_2.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, every circuit in the full Li-Yang B2 model computing f_n has at least (7/2)n - 56 n^(4/5) - (35/2) n^(3/5) - 7 gates for every integer n >= 10^7, all k prefix bits being counted in n; hence C_B2(f_n) >= (7/2)n - o(n) at every sufficiently large integer length n = |x|.
